article_context: 解释超市通过延长顾客停留时间和提供海量选择来增加购买，并指出持续决策会造成信息过载，使购物者逐渐从理性选择转向情绪化购买。

article.title: 翻译 · 超市如何让消费者从理性选择转向情绪购物
article.background: 解释超市通过延长顾客停留时间和提供海量选择来增加购买，并指出持续决策会造成信息过载，使购物者逐渐从理性选择转向情绪化购买。

sentences.en: The supermarket is designed to lure customers into spending as much time as possible within its doors.
sentences.zh: 超市的设计目的，是尽可能把顾客留在店内更长时间。

segments.text: The supermarket is designed to lure customers into spending as much time as possible within its doors.

sentences.en: The reason for this is simple: The longer you stay in the store, the more stuff you'll see, and the more stuff you see, the more you'll buy.
sentences.zh: 原因很简单：你在店里待得越久，看到的商品就越多；看到的越多，买下的也就越多。

segments.text: The reason for this is simple: The longer you stay in the store, the more stuff you'll see, and the more stuff you see, the more you'll buy.

sentences.en: And supermarkets contain a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 而超市里的商品确实多得惊人。

segments.text: And supermarkets contain a lot of stuff.

sentences.en: The average supermarket, according to the Food Marketing Institute, carries some 44,000 different items, and many carry tens of thousands more.
sentences.zh: 根据食品营销协会的数据，一家普通超市大约会经营4.4万种不同商品，许多超市甚至还要多出数万种。

segments.text: The average supermarket, according to the Food Marketing Institute, carries some 44,000 different items, and many carry tens of thousands more.

sentences.en: The sheer volume of available choice is enough to send shoppers into a state of information overload.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是如此庞大的选择数量，就足以让购物者陷入信息过载。

segments.text: The sheer volume of available choice is enough to send shoppers into a state of information overload.

sentences.en: According to brain-scan experiments, the demands of so much decision-making quickly become too much for us.
sentences.zh: 脑部扫描实验表明，如此大量的决策需求很快就会超过我们的承受能力。

segments.text: According to brain-scan experiments, the demands of so much decision-making quickly become too much for us.

sentences.en: After about 40 minutes of shopping, most people stop struggling to be rationally selective, and instead begin shopping emotionally - which is the point at which we accumulate the 50 percent of stuff in our cart that we never intended buying.
sentences.zh: 购物大约40分钟后，大多数人便不再努力保持理性和选择性，而开始凭情绪购物；也正是在这一阶段，我们会把许多原本没打算买的东西放进购物车，而它们最终可占购物车中商品的一半。

segments.text: After about 40 minutes of shopping, most people stop struggling to be rationally selective, and instead begin shopping emotionally - which is the point at which we accumulate the 50 percent of stuff in our cart that we never intended buying.
